narrative.overview: Pagelea pairs an approachable public identity with restrained professional product chrome. The editor becomes quiet, dense, and predictable so the PDF remains the dominant object. Large screens keep context visible; narrow screens use explicit drawers and bottom sheets instead of stacking the application beneath the document.
keyCharacteristics: Local-first confidence with restrained green state accents.
Neutral layered surfaces that separate navigation from document content.
Familiar editor geometry and consistent 4-pixel spacing increments.
Structural responsive changes instead of scaled-down desktop chrome.
Fast state transitions with no decorative product animation.

rules.name: The Document Colour Rule
rules.body: Green communicates readiness and privacy; blue communicates document selection.

rules.name: The Page-First Elevation Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the workbench may cast a stronger resting shadow than the PDF page except an open modal sheet or drawer.

dos: Do give the PDF the largest continuous viewport available.
Do keep coarse-pointer targets at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.
Do preserve the same core capabilities across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
donts: Don't ship a document editor embedded inside a marketing-page card or constrained canvas.
Don't stack desktop panels into a long scrolling page on mobile.
Don't rely on hover-dependent controls or hidden core functionality.
